scope: The standing Lares hacienda visitor precinct at the municipality’s published location, with the timber casa grande, coffee-processing balcony range, courtyard-side dependencies and the glácil drying terrace.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: Municipal visitor directions resolve to the developed hacienda site on the mapped hillside property.

Municipal fact-sheet transcription identifies wood house over brick, zinc gable, lower shops and stores, two-story balcony machine building, brick cistern, a masonry 100 by 50 ft drying terrace, and former waterwheel.
Municipal and state planning document identifies the historic resource as Hacienda La Paragua / Hacienda Lealtad, SHPO LR020008.
